BM25 filter works during multi-page crawl, keeping relevant pages

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import crawl, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        bm25_query="rust programming",
        bm25_threshold=0.1,
        content_filter="bm25",
        max_concurrent=1,
        max_depth=1,
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(result.pages[0].html)

asyncio.run(main())
```
